verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms Plaid IDV uses a Link-based flow with client-side callbacks (onEvent, onSuccess) and documentary verification, but nowhere does it describe native iOS/Android/web SDK camera capture guidance features like glare, blur, or edge detection coaching. Missing for 10: any documentation of platform-specific SDKs, camera capture UI, or real-time image-quality coaching (glare/blur/edge detection).
